correctness.rationale: At t=0 the two distinct active eigenvalues ensure the two-column CG moment Gram matrix is positive definite. Its analytic polynomial minimizer has roots at beta and gamma. Differentiating the matrix polynomial cancels the off-cluster blocks identically; minimizing the leading energy over two independent coefficient variations removes within-cluster components parallel to the respective right-hand-side projections. The squared error is the squared inverse-C0 residual norm, yielding both coefficients, their exact vanishing condition and O(t^4) in the zero case. A symmetric block has twice the squared norm of its off-diagonal coupling, so a rank-two unit-Frobenius within-cluster block attains the sharp worst-case constant. Exact-rational code checked 560 samples plus direct CG examples and two sharpness configurations. Generality follows from the proof, not finite checks.

value.rationale: An exact all-multiplicity within-cluster anisotropy criterion resolves the leading perturbation response of a two-step Krylov solver at a resonant spectral-preconditioner placement excluded from a recent noncollision theorem. It reveals unconditional cancellation of cross-cluster couplings, a sharp Frobenius-adversarial coefficient with explicit rank-two extremizers, and a distinction between quadratic and quartic squared-error orders, relevant to recycled preconditioner sensitivity without claiming a broad complexity theorem.
